name: libultrahdr
description: Reference codec for the Ultra HDR format

repo.name: libultrahdr
repo.description: Ultra HDR is a true HDR image format, and is backcompatible.  libultrahdr is the reference codec for the Ultra HDR format.  The codecs that support the format can render the HDR intent of the image on HDR displays;  other codecs can still decode and display the SDR intent of the image.

readme.summary: The README provides a solid conceptual overview and API reference table, but lacks inline examples and defers most practical guidance to external files.
readme.top_issue: No quick-start code example — users are redirected to a separate demo app file rather than seeing a minimal working snippet inline.

common_complaints: Missing Apple gain map format decoding support
Apache 2.0 license incompatible with GPLv2 (blocking WordPress adoption)
Windows platform issues (Chinese character paths, Unicode handling)
Limited input/output format options (raw buffers only)
praise_themes: Library is valuable enough for major projects (WordPress) to seek integration
Users actively filing detailed feature requests and bug reports
Some issues successfully resolved (gainmap_weight bug fix, transcoding feature closure)
